He mirrored Ricky Ponting's tally of 1,971 runs against New Zealand and became the first player to hit 13,000 runs batting at number three in ODIs. Kohli's stellar performance highlighted his consistent excellence, driving India to a celebrated victory.
title: Sachin Tendulkar's record gone! Virat Kohli creates history during India's NZ chase

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: SC issues notice to Centre, poll body on blanket immunity to CEC

author: AASHISH SAXENA
description: In a surprising twist during the 2026 US midterm elections, the Democrats regained control of Congress, managing to flip a number of Republican-held districts. Candidates endorsed by Trump faced unexpected defeats in what were once viewed as secure territories. Economic turmoil and the escalating situation in Iran played crucial roles in shaping voter decisions.
title: Blue trumps Red: 10 key takeaways from US midterm elections

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Mayweather faces reported $340k rent order over $100k-a-month Manhattan flat

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: Hardik's future has emerged as the biggest talking point of the trading season.
title: IPL: MI, PBKS in talks over Hardik Pandya, Arshdeep Singh trade

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Iran war, inflation or Trump fatigue: What drove Democrats' midterm surge?

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: Democrats dominate Congress as blue wave breaks Republican strongholds: Key points

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Pakistan has announced the successful test flight of its indigenously developed air-to-air missile called Fa'az. This missile features a terminal guidance system, designed for engaging aerial targets at long ranges. The flight test was observed by military officials and scientists involved in its development. Simultaneously, India is working on its own Astra family of missiles to enhance air defense capabilities.
title: Pakistan tests Fa'az air-to-air missile, but reach and speed remain a mystery

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh emphasized the importance of indigenous weapons development during the Delhi Defence Dialogue. He stated that self-reliance in defense means reducing external dependencies while improving technological capabilities. The government aims to increase defense production and exports significantly by 2029 through enhanced private participation and collaboration. Additionally, he highlighted the need for armed forces involvement in research and development to drive innovation.
title: Defence production at Rs 1.78 lakh crore: Rajnath Singh sets out India's next priorities

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Arshdeep's spell is the fourth-best by an Indian pacer in New Zealand. Srinath holds the top two positions with figures of 4/23 in Auckland in 2003 and 4/52 in Napier in 1995. Shami is third with 4/55 in Napier in 2014.
title: Arshdeep joins Srinath and Shami in elite list as India bowl out NZ for 185

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Jon Rosenthal, representing the Democratic Party, has made a significant breakthrough by winning the Texas Railroad Commission, marking a notable end to Republican rule. This election, intensified by Bo French's divisive comments about South Asian students, has captured national headlines. Rosenthal aims to implement stricter regulatory measures for the oil and gas industry, drawing on his experience as a former engineer and commitment to environmental enhancement in Texas.
title: Texas railroad commission race: Bo French, Republican who sparked anti-India row, defeated

author: ANURAG BENDE
title: PM Modi calls Sharad Pawar; advises complete rest

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Guess my election-interfering space lasers didn’t work': Musk on $445m failed gamble

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Virat Kohli celebrated a monumental achievement, becoming the first to score 13,000 runs while batting at No. 3 in ODIs during India's opening match against New Zealand at Eden Park. With a striking career average of 61.61, Kohli's performance was stellar. India excelled overall, bowling New Zealand out for a mere 185 runs and Kohli further impressed with an outstanding catch.
title: Virat Kohli scripts history in Auckland, becomes first batter to achieve this feat

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: The match was initially stopped in the 11th over of India's chase of 186, with the visitors at 29/1. Kohli was batting on 29, while Gill was on 17.
title: 'Can't see the ball': Kohli, Gill angry as play continues in rain in Auckland

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma criticized Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's proposal for a public debate with Prime Minister Modi. Sarma emphasized that such discussions should occur in Parliament, not publicly. He challenged Gandhi to raise various critical issues like Bofors and the Bhopal Gas Tragedy during parliamentary sessions. Rahul Gandhi had expressed a desire for a debate to address national connections and financial matters.
title: 'Debate in Parliament': Himanta Sarma hits back at Rahul Gandhi's challenge to PM Modi

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Midterm results: Americans get tired of president, 'vote out' Republicans

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: 'Trump hasn’t done anything to help': Republicans blame MAGA chief for midterm rout

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission in Punjab ruled that a car dealer must refund a buyer for a blacklisted vehicle. The buyer purchased a second-hand Maruti WagonR, which was later found to be blacklisted. The dealer failed to verify the vehicle's legal status before selling it, leading to a deficiency in service. While the buyer incurred significant expenses, the commission only ordered a partial refund.
title: Man buys used car for Rs 2.51 lakh, finds it blacklisted; dealer told to refund

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Elon Musk expressed interest in building data centers in space after the mid-term elections favored Democrats. His posts came after significant Democratic gains, including a surprise victory in Texas' governor's race. Democrats' success has drawn attention to the AI industry's impact on data infrastructure expansions. Musk's remarks hint at the growing scrutiny over the environmental effects of data centers. The mid-term elections also celebrated historic milestones in American political representation.
title: Hours after mid-term election results, Musk sends 'let's go to Space' message

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Radhika Apte delves into the intricate dynamics of motherhood, recounting her struggles to juggle her career alongside her family responsibilities. She candidly shares her day-to-day life, where she cooks for her loved ones and handles every household task independently. Opening up about her emotional landscape, Radhika addresses postpartum depression and guilt, advocating for a society where the complex truths of motherhood are acknowledged beyond the expectation of unwavering joy.
title: 'Brain fogged and sleep deprived': Radhika Apte opens up about motherhood

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In 1947, a Bedouin shepherd stumbled upon the Dead Sea Scrolls while searching for stray animals. This discovery consisted of numerous ancient manuscripts that greatly impacted historical and religious studies. The manuscripts date back to the Second Temple period, offering insights into diverse Jewish beliefs and practices. Researchers continue to piece together fragments to reveal their contents and historical significance.
title: Teen's thrown stone led to discovery of ancient Dead Sea Scrolls

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The death toll from the October 10 attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has now reached 14. An Indian national with critical injuries has recently died in the hospital after the strike. The Indian Embassy has provided assistance to the victim's family regarding repatriation or funeral arrangements. Initial reports indicated 12 deaths and 309 injuries, however, numbers have since increased.
title: Riyadh airport attack: 2nd Indian national succumbs to injuries, death toll reaches 14

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: Kamboj has had forgettable outings in international cricket but he ensured Auckland didn't follow the pattern. With relentless lengths, sharp use of the wobble seam and speeds, the highly-rated Haryana bowler showed why the management didn't give up on him.
title: AK47 finds the target: Relentless Kamboj reaps benefits of better planning

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Abdul El-Sayed won the Michigan Senate race against Republican Mike Rogers, marking a significant milestone in history. His victory speech included pointed remarks aimed at both Vice President JD Vance and former President Trump. El-Sayed's campaign focused on progressive issues such as universal healthcare and criticized outside influence in elections. The election was closely contested, with substantial spending from various interest groups.
title: ‘Habibi, call me Senator’: Abdul El-Sayed mocks Trump, Vance in victory speech

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Point of Law, a three-year-old former charge of King Charles III, triumphed in the prestigious Melbourne Cup at Flemington. Trainer Ciaron Maher celebrated an extraordinary trifecta as his horses secured the top three spots. This victory followed Point of Law's stunning debut triumph at the Geelong Cup, building great anticipation for the Melbourne Cup.
title: King Charles sold racehorse months before it won Melbourne Cup in sixth start

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded Melania Trump the Order of Princess Olga for her humanitarian work. She was instrumental in organizing a humanitarian evacuation from the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. An important ceasefire allowed nearly 800 residents to access emergency supplies and evacuate safely. Melania Trump is hosting representatives from both Russia and Ukraine to discuss the ceasefire efforts.
title: Zelenskyy honours Melania Trump for helping secure ceasefire in Russian-occupied Oleshky

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Mark and Mary Stevens have made a historic investment of $175 million to create a pioneering medical school in Santa Clara, named the Mark & Mary Stevens School of Medicine. The institution aims to revolutionize healthcare with AI and is set to cover 82,000 square feet, featuring classrooms and labs for about 120 students per cohort.
title: Nvidia’s Mark Stevens, wife donate $175M for AI-focused Bay Area medical school

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: The unfavourable midterm election outcome is unlikely to prompt President Donald Trump to change course on trade, according to an analysis by Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI). Trump is now likely to use his executive authority to push India towards an early agreement that opens up the Indian market to American agricultural and industrial products, while securing other significant concessions for US businesses.
title: Midterm blues: Why 'lame' duck Donald may push for a quick India-US trade deal

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: In an exhilarating start to the ODI series, Virat Kohli's innings of 74 runs propelled India to a crucial five-wicket win over New Zealand. Despite rain interruptions, India's pace attack, spearheaded by Arshdeep Singh's four wickets, limited New Zealand to 185. Kohli paired brilliantly with Shubman Gill, guiding India efficiently through the revised target under Duckworth-Lewis-Stern. This victory marks India's lead in the five-match series.
title: Kohli's 74, Arshdeep's 4-wicket haul guide India to victory against New Zealand

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The 2026 US midterm elections have led to historic firsts in gubernatorial and Senate races across the nation. Notable victories include the first Black woman governor in US history and the first Native American woman governor. The election of Texas' first Latina governor and Florida's first Black governor also signify progress in representation. Additionally, Minnesota has elected its first woman governor, further enhancing diversity in leadership roles.
title: Historic 1st in US midterms: Black, Indigenous, Latina & LGBTQ leaders win key races

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
title: 'Walked into room with tattoos': Rahul recalls first meeting with Sidhu Moosewala

author: ROHITASHWA RANJAN
title: Good news for Agniveers: Government extends tenure by two years

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
title: Historic win for Democrats in Kansas, Hamilton flips Senate seat after 94 yrs

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Indian equities are already contending with a range of domestic market pressures. Uncertainty surrounding Donald Trump's tariff decisions, higher crude oil prices and bond yields, along with sustained foreign institutional investor (FII) selling, has pushed the Sensex and Nifty down. In this environment, investors are watching the US midterm elections for clues about their possible impact on global financial markets.
title: How does Trump's defeat in US midterms impact Indian stock market? Explained

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In Punjab, a district consumer commission has ordered an insurance company to pay compensation for a stolen vehicle after initially denying the claim on the grounds of a late theft report. Upon review, the commission found no substantiation for the insurer's allegations of misrepresentation. Thus, the validity of the insurance policy was confirmed, with the company required to compensate the claimant with Rs 3.5 lakh plus interest.
title: Bolero stolen a day after premium payment; commission orders insurer to pay Rs 3.5 lakh

author: SHUBHANSHU DWIVEDI
description: Kohli took a low catch at second slip to dismiss Nathan Smith in the 29th over off Anshul Kamboj, reducing New Zealand to 115/7.
title: Virat Kohli's stunning catch, Rohit Sharma's run-out lights up Auckland ODI

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Milner Police Chief Lamar Bunn and most officers resigned amidst allegations of unethical conduct by city leadership. Bunn accused the city manager of placing a GPS tracker on his personal vehicle without consent. The city's leadership faced claims of legal compliance issues that impacted police operations and officer ethics. Police Captain Craig Walton urged for an independent investigation into Mayor Craig Timmons' conduct.
title: Georgia’s entire police force quits; chief accuses city manager of GPS tracking

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: North Korea recently fired multiple missiles towards its eastern waters, indicating rising tensions with South Korea and the US. This action followed North Korea's denial of involvement in a significant cryptocurrency hack attributed to its hackers by the FBI. Kim Yo Jong criticized US accusations as part of a hostile policy and refused dialogue until it changes.
title: North Korea fires missiles hours after rejecting US accusations over Binance hack

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: 'I wasn't on ballot': Trump shrugs of midterm drubbing, shares photo of what's to come

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: The 2026 US midterm elections saw a significant turnaround for the Democrats, who successfully overturned several Republican-held positions. They secured a vital Senate seat in North Carolina and won the governorship in Georgia. Gains in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Kentucky, and Iowa underscored a shift in political dynamics, with Roy Cooper and Annie Andrews emerging victorious in their Senate races. These outcomes herald a challenging phase for Trump's party.
title: US midterms: Red alert for Republicans as Democrats notch stunning flips

author: AADRITA HALDER
title: Indian-American candidates shine in US midterms 2026: Who won from where? Full list

author: MUKUT DAS
description: Ghanakanta Gogoi was killed in police firing while attempting to escape from custody in Sivasagar. The incident occurred after he snatched a police officer's weapon and shot at the police. Gogoi had previously surrendered to police with a firearm linked to the Hotel Bilas Inn shooting. This shooting resulted in the deaths of five individuals connected to the hotel.
title: Accused in Guwahati hotel shooting shot dead in encounter

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: Spain’s transport minister Óscar Puente resigned after a high-speed train collision near Madrid caused 69 fatalities. This incident was the second major rail disaster on the Madrid-Seville route in just one year. Following the October 28 crash, Puente faced pressure from opposition politicians and railway unions demanding his resignation. He acknowledged responsibility for the accidents and announced measures to improve railway safety.
title: Spain transport minister Óscar Puente quits 6 days after train disaster kills 69

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: At 4pm on Tuesday, Delhi's air quality index fell to a concerning level of 350, with certain areas like Jahangirpuri reporting a hazardous AQI of 462. Monitoring agencies warn that the city's air quality may worsen, largely due to rising emissions from stubble burning in nearby states. Experts predict that the adverse weather conditions will result in six more days of poor air quality across the region.
title: November pain: Air quality severe in parts of Delhi

author: ROSY SEQUEIRA
description: Bombay High Court expressed disappointment over BMC's removal of an anti-cracker video featuring actor Dia Mirza. The court highlighted the importance of public participation in addressing pollution and suggested reinstating the video. Additionally, judges were disturbed by negative comments concerning celebrities engaged in public awareness efforts. They emphasized the need for support during such initiatives, especially when guided by court directions.
title: 'Aren't we secular?' HC asks BMC to restore actor Dia Mirza's anti-cracker post

author: VISHANT AGARWALA
title: 50 years after Nepal banned cannabis, top court orders regulated cultivation

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Ollie Watkins’ wife, Ellie, has returned to the UK with their two children months after his reported £50 million move from Aston Villa to Al-Hilal. Citing security concerns and regional conflict in Saudi Arabia, she said the family would stay in Britain until conditions improve. Watkins, meanwhile, continues his career in Riyadh, having recorded six goals and five assists in 10 appearances.
title: Ollie Watkins' wife Ellie returns to UK with kids amid Saudi security concerns

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion project faces fresh opposition as neighbours raise concerns about potential damage to a century-old sewer line from planned landscaping. Despite spending $7,500 on repairs and revising fence plans, Kelce’s team has encountered another setback. Local officials approved some landscaping but rejected shoreline tree plans, asking for further revisions before granting approval.
title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion makeover hits another roadblock

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce’s mother Donna Kelce reflects on motherhood.
title: Travis Kelce's mother Donna reveals why motherhood can be harder than work

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Bharat Sisodia and his team moved a 100-year-old peepal tree after it was cut down in Ahmedabad. They found that part of the original root system was still alive and nurtured it. This work emphasized the need for ongoing maintenance and care after transplanting trees. While the tree began to show new growth, it still faced potential threats from development projects.
title: Man uses 50-tonne crane to move 100-year-old peepal tree 2 km

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In Bihar's Nalanda district, Anita Devi ventured into mushroom farming to uplift her family's financial situation. Initially faced with skepticism from her community, her unwavering dedication culminated in the formation of the Madhopur Farmers Producers Company, which by 2025 embraced 512 farmers and provided vital agricultural resources. Devi's initiative has empowered local women and promoted self-sufficiency, with aspirations to expand into diverse produce like makhana.
title: Bihar woman turns village into ‘Mushroom Village’, empowers 250 women

author: TNN
title: Take on PM Modi in Parliament, Sitharaman tells Rahul on debate challenge

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Indian-origin Suhas Subramanyam wins re-election to US House from Virginia

author: TNN
description: Assistant Commissioner Manasvi Vashistha was suspended for protesting his transfer along with Inspector Arun Kumar. The protest occurred after an incident involving lawyers at Shahdara police station, resulting in a serious injury to an advocate. Vashistha had previously called for clearer procedures for interactions between police and lawyers. He led the demonstration, which was dismissed as an interaction by the police.
title: ACP who led police protest suspended

author: TNN
description: During the weekend, a man named Prabhuraj entered a shoe repair shop in Indiranagar. He threatened the employee, Jayashree, with a knife and applied superglue to her hands. After immobilizing her, he stole her gold mangalsutra worth Rs 4.5 lakh. Members of the public chased him, leading to his arrest after a dramatic encounter. Police reported that Jayashree was safe and unhurt following the incident.
title: Thief glues woman’s hands, grabs Rs 4.5L gold chain in Bengaluru

author: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA
title: Judge facing rape charge presides over Pocso court

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Justin Baldoni has sold his three-bedroom Culver City home for $2.1 million after relocating to Nashville with his family. The ‘It Ends With Us’ director bought the California property for $1.04 million in 2017 and renovated it extensively. The sale comes amid the high-profile legal dispute with former co-star Blake Lively.
title: Justin Baldoni sells LA home for $2.1M amid Lively legal fight

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Katy Perry’s proposed Gratitude Canyon youth camp in Goleta, California, is facing opposition from more than 360 neighbours. Residents have raised concerns about wildfire risks, traffic, noise and evacuation access. The singer’s Firework Foundation is defending the project, saying it will provide underserved children with opportunities to explore arts, nature and outdoor activities.
title: Katy Perry's 110-acre youth camp faces opposition from 360 neighbours

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: With the launch of RunX, Kridha Gupta aimed to establish a safe running community for women in Ambala. As memberships surged, the group pivoted towards campaigns for enhanced public safety and lighting. Their proactive community engagement led to successful fundraising for streetlights, alongside productive dialogues with local governance. Additionally, Kridha's initiative included educational workshops for students, illustrating how collective actions can foster substantial community growth.
title: Class 12 student starts women-only running club, raises Rs 8L for streetlights

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Michael Vaughan has spotlighted India's ongoing struggles with fielding as the BCCI seeks a new fielding coach. Recent matches, particularly during the Women's T20 World Cup, have revealed troubling catching mistakes, including in a series against Zimbabwe. With the BCCI insisting on high standards for applicants, India's tour of South Africa will be crucial for enhancing their performance and addressing these critical issues.
title: ‘I'll be the fielding coach’: Ex-cricketer mocks India as BCCI invites applications

author: AMIT ANAND CHOUDHARY
description: The National Medical Commission has officially approved a shift from a percentile to a rank-based system for NEET admissions, which aims to improve the current postgraduate medical course admission process. This change comes amid concerns over the possible decrease in qualifying scores for NEET-PG 2025. The commission is focused on preserving the integrity of medical examinations and has also suggested equitable salary structures for medical residents.
title: Rank-based merit list to replace percentile for NEET PG: Panel to SC

author: TNN
description: Deoria police arrested a school manager for allegedly killing a teacher who demanded marriage. The accused, Vijay Nishad, reportedly strangled Rani Vishwakarma following an argument in his car. After committing the crime, he hid her body in the vehicle's boot and disposed of it near a school. Police reconstructed the events from his confession and gathered evidence from the scene.
title: Teacher killed, body kept in car boot for hours; UP school manager arrested

author: MADHU RASALA
description: Sunitha, a 28-year-old woman, was murdered by her in-laws due to a land dispute in Mahbubnagar. They were allegedly angered by the transfer of 1.5 acres of land registered in her name. Sunitha's in-laws dragged her to their home and brutally beheaded her. The police launched an investigation after her father reported the incident. The accused are currently absconding, and special teams are working to locate them.
title: Telangana woman dragged to in-laws’ home, beheaded over 1.5-acre land dispute

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Pennsylvania woman received breast cancer treatment for 13 months before doctors discovered she had a rare and aggressive lymphoma. She died in January 2019, and her family sued the treating oncologist, alleging that the delayed diagnosis reduced her chances of survival. After a trial court dismissed the case, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled that a jury should hear the malpractice claim.
title: Pennsylvania court revives family's cancer malpractice suit after woman's death

author: VISHANT V AGARWALA
title: Indian tourist killed, PIO injured as copters collide during Everest rescue

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
title: Watch: Nasa astronaut Anil Menon shows how ISS crew cast ballots from space

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a lighthearted moment during a Fox News interview, Donald Trump playfully proposed his candidacy for the position of Israel's prime minister, citing a staggering 99 percent approval rating among Israelis. He went on to declare that by 2026, the US would cease its annual aid of $4 billion to Israel, sparking considerable debate over the implications for military support and relations, coinciding with the midterm elections unfolding in America.
title: 'Will move to Israel, become PM': Trump jokes on his approval ratings amid US midterms
